name: @wxyc/observability
description: Cross-container observability primitives: Sentry transaction/span filter predicates (BS#2089, package root — dropping liveness-route transactions and Express middleware bookkeeping spans) and a generic buffered CloudWatch metric emitter (BS#2169, `./metrics` subpath). Consumed by apps/backend and apps/auth so both containers share byte-identical implementations.
author: WXYC
